svg.title: Fix a rule, follow its questions
svg.text: Fix a rule, follow its questions
Day 06's names rule, fixed, on 41 new questions.
+ Berlin, Paris, “Do…?”, “Who…?” − “Does…?” was refused by accident
Tokyo, the virus question, Berlin, register the trip
a lifted refusal hands the question to the next stage
THE BAR, SET IN ADVANCE: LOSE NOTHING
4 more answerable kept, 1 fewer refusal: not adopted
the new test split decided twice: now it's used too
next: Day 11, the section next door
